name: Plajah VJ — Maschine Studio
author: Plajah Pixels Auto-Map
description: Performance-optimised 4×4 pad + 8-knob layout for live AV sets. Bottom row = safe core scenes you return to constantly. Top row = macro FX toggles. Knobs ordered by live-performance priority — K1 (Sensitivity) is your #1 dial.
midi_mode_instructions: 1. Press SHIFT + CONTROL on Maschine Studio to enter MIDI mode.
2. In MIDI mode pads send Note On/Off on MIDI channel 10 (notes 60–75).
3. The 8 top rotary encoders send CC 14–21 (Group A).
4. Open Plajah Pixels → Settings → MIDI tab — device auto-detects.
5. Pads light up in the UI as you hit them; knob rings animate live.

pads._layout: 4×4 grid. row=1 is the BOTTOM row (closest to you). col=1 is LEFT.

row_1_bottom_core_scenes.label: SPECTR
row_1_bottom_core_scenes.description: Classic frequency spectrum bars — safe fallback, always looks good

row_1_bottom_core_scenes.label: WAVE
row_1_bottom_core_scenes.description: Waveform oscilloscope line — clean and minimal

row_1_bottom_core_scenes.label: NEBULA
row_1_bottom_core_scenes.description: Cosmic nebula cloud — rich and layered

row_2_dynamic_scenes.label: STORM
row_2_dynamic_scenes.description: Electric storm — high energy, great for drops

row_3_studio_engine_webgl.label: AURORA
row_3_studio_engine_webgl.description: Aurora Drift — WebGL aurora borealis curtain

row_3_studio_engine_webgl.label: GRAVTY
row_3_studio_engine_webgl.description: Gravity Wells — orbiting attractors bending light

row_4_top_macro_toggles.label: BASS↑
row_4_top_macro_toggles.description: Toggle bass camera shake — punch on every kick

row_4_top_macro_toggles.label: GLITCH
row_4_top_macro_toggles.description: Toggle VGA jitter glitch — digital corruption effect

row_4_top_macro_toggles.label: PALET
row_4_top_macro_toggles.description: Rotate active color palette — instant mood shift

knobs._layout: 8 rotary encoders, left to right. CC 14–21 in Group A. In MIDI mode these are endless encoders sending relative or absolute values depending on firmware.
knobs._priority: Ordered by live-performance criticality — K1 is the dial you reach for first.

assignments.label: Sensitivity
assignments.tip: Primary reactivity dial — crank on drops, ease back for breakdowns

assignments.label: Glow
assignments.tip: Visual bloom/halo level — push high for ethereal feel

assignments.label: Speed
assignments.tip: Animation velocity — slow for ambient, fast for high energy

assignments.label: Beat Pulse
assignments.tip: How hard the background pulses with the kick — sync to the room

assignments.label: Layer Blend
assignments.tip: Crossfade the second media overlay in/out

assignments.label: Lighting
assignments.tip: Stage beam/spotlight intensity — strobe-like at max

assignments.label: Blur
assignments.tip: Soft focus / motion-blur strength — dreamy at high values

assignments.label: Particles
assignments.tip: Particle emitter density — dense for 'stars everywhere' look

extra_cc_group_b._note: CC 22–31 are available for additional hardware (second controller, faders, extra knobs).

standard_cc.label: Mod Wheel
standard_cc.note: Touch strip / mod — routes to CC 1 on most devices, future: smoothing time
